Select FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate As LCDate,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RetirementDate, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount as FCAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencyID ,SET_Currency.CurrencyName +'-'+ SET_Currency.CurrencySign as CurrencyName, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Rate As ConvertionRate,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName As BankBranchName, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.AccountNo, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as VendorName, PONO as ContractNo,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as ContractDate, case When IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode = 1 then 'Self' When IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode = 2 then 'FATR' When IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode = 3 then 'Usance' end as LCOption, IMP_LCRetirement.MaturityDate, IMP_LCRetirement.NoOfDays from FA_LetterOfCreditHeader Inner JOin SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID AND SET_Currency.Status = 1
left JOin IMP_LCRetirement on IMP_LCRetirement.LCNo = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo AND IMP_LCRetirement.LCHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCHeaderID
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.VendorID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status =1
left Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.FiscalID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status =1
Where FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 And FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate --AND (FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo = @LCNO Or @LCNO is null)

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging_ForApprove
data.value:
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCHeaderID desc) AS 'Row' FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT poh_Outer.LCHeaderID, poh_Outer.CompanyID, poh_Outer.PeriodID, poh_Outer.Status, poh_Outer.TypeCode, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, poh_Outer.DocumentNumber, poh_Outer.DocumentDate, ISNULL(poh_Outer.VendorID, '-1') as VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, poh_Outer.AcceptanceDueDate, poh_Outer.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByvalue, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID as UserID ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,poh_Outer.LCNo FROM FA_LetterOfCreditHeader poh_Outer INNER JOIN FA_LetterOfCreditDetail pod ON pod.LCHeaderID = poh_Outer.LCHeaderID And poh_Outer.status = 1 AND pod.Status = 1 AND pod.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND pod.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on poh_Outer.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.Customerid = poh_Outer.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = poh_Outer.DocumentNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode AND DocumentNo = poh_Outer.DocumentNumber)
inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = poh_Outer.TypeCode OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = poh_Outer.LCHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT poh.TotalAmount FROM AP_PurchaseOrderHeader poh WHERE poh.CompanyID = poh_Outer.CompanyID AND poh.PeriodID = poh_Outer.PeriodID AND poh.POHeaderID = poh_Outer.LCHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) --AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = poh_Outer.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL)
LEFT join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND (UsersInRoles.userID = poh_Outer.CreatedBy OR UsersInRoles.userID IS NULL) ) AP_PurchaseOrderHeader

data.name: Query_BankwiseLCDetail
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-06-18 00:00:00:000'
Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo asc) AS 'Row' ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate as LCDate ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName As BankBranchName --,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.AccountNo ,SUM(isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.Quantity,0)) as Quantity ,SET_Currency.CurrencySign ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount as FCAmount ,Sum((isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount,0) * isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Rate,0))) as AmountPKR ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RetirementDate ,(case When IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode = 1 then IMP_LCRetirement.LCValue * 0 else 0 end) as SelfPKR --'Self (PKR)' ,(case When IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode = 2 then IMP_LCRetirement.LCValue * 0 else 0 end) as FATRPKR --'FATR (PKR)' --,case When IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode = 3 then 'Usance (PKR)' end as LCOption ,IMP_LCRetirement.MaturityDate ,AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate as ShipmentDate ,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(SUM(AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity),2)) as ShipmentQuantity ,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) as RecievedQty ,Convert(decimal(18,2),Round(SUM(AP_SaleContractDetail.Quantity) - Isnull(SUM(SET_WeightSubDetail.Quantity),0),2)) as IntransitQty
from FA_LetterOfCreditHeader
left join FA_LetterOfCreditDetail on FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.LCHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCHeaderID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.Status = 1
left JOin SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID AND SET_Currency.Status = 1
left JOin IMP_LCRetirement on IMP_LCRetirement.LCNo = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo AND IMP_LCRetirement.LCHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCHeaderID AND IMP_LCRetirement.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID AND IMP_LCRetirement.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and IMP_LCRetirement.Status = 1
left join AP_SaleContractHeader on AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.SaleContractID and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1
left join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_SaleContractHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
left join AP_SaleContractDetail on AP_SaleContractDetail.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID and AP_SaleContractDetail.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID and AP_SaleContractDetail.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID and AP_SaleContractDetail.Status = 1
left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SaleContractID = AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = AP_SaleContractHeader.Status
left join SET_WeightAssessmentHeader on SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.BL = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.Status = 1
left join SET_WeightSubDetail on SET_WeightSubDetail.WeightAssessmentID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.WeightAssessmentID and SET_WeightSubDetail.CompanyID = SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID and SET_WeightSubDetail.Status = 1 and SET_WeightSubDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.BLNo = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = AP_SaleContractDetail.ItemID
Where FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 And FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate --and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Purchase Contract - Raw Material' and AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1 and AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
Group By FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.TotalAmount,SET_Currency.CurrencySign,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RetirementDate ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName,IMP_LCRetirement.LCOptionCode,IMP_LCRetirement.LCValue,IMP_LCRetirement.MaturityDate,AP_SaleContractHeader.DocumentDate ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate

BilledLocationName, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DateOfShipment, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DateOfExpire, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PortOfShipment, FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PortOfDischarge, Case when FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RateType = 1 then 'DemandDraft' when FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RateType = 2 then 'Ready' when FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.RateType = 3 then 'TelegraphicTransfer' when isnull([FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].FreightAmount,0) as FreightAmount, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ItemDescription, INV_Item.Description, round((case when [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].Rate IS NOT NULL then [FA_LetterOfCreditDetail].[Quantity] * [FA_LetterOfCreditDetail].[UnitPrice] * [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].Rate else [FA_LetterOfCreditDetail].[Quantity] * [FA_LetterOfCreditDetail].[UnitPrice] end ),2)as GrossAmount, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ItemID, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ItemUOMID, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ListPricePerUnit, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.MarketPrice, FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.SerialNo, ISNULL(FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.NetAmount, 0) as NetAmount, isnull(FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ForexValue,0) as ForexValue
--round(FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.Quantity * FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.UnitPrice, 2) as GrossAmount,
FROM [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader] Inner join FA_LetterOfCreditDetail on FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.LCHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCHeaderID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.Status = 1 and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = 1 LEFT JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].VendorQuoteNumber LEFT JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] ON [SET_Location].[LocationID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[ShipToLocationID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] AS BilledLocation ON BilledLocation.[LocationID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[BillToLocationID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Term] ON [SET_Term].[TermID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[TermsID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Currency] ON [SET_Currency].[CurrencyID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[CurrencyID] LEFT JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[VendorID] --AND [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[CompanyID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[PeriodID] LEFT JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[StockRequisitionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].[PeriodID] INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [FA_LetterOfCreditHeader].TypeCode INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ItemUOMID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CategoryID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Tax ON AR_SET_Tax.TaxID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.TaxID --AND AR_SET_Tax.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Tax.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.PeriodID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.poheaderid = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.LCHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.companyid = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.companyid and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.PeriodID
WHERE FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 And FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%' {0}
Order by FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentNumber
